d: Janta dal yunaited (JDU) dvara kal manae gae sushasan divas aur mukhyamantri ke bihar daure ko lekar bihar vidhanasbha ke neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne apni pratikriya dete hue rajy sarkar par nishana sadha hai. midiya se batchit men neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne rajy ki maujuda sthiti, bhrashtachar, prati vyakti aay aur mukhyamantri ki samiksha yatra par kaee saval uthae.
